title: Pricing Matrix
subtitle: Read-only view of pricing policies, channel lifecycle, and unit declarations.
readOnlyNote: Channel activation, pricing preview, and apply are not available in this release. You can browse existing configuration and create new immutable policy and product group revisions below.
state.permissionDenied.title: You don't have access to pricing
state.permissionDenied.message: Your account lacks the workspace read permission required to view pricing configuration.
state.unavailable.title: Pricing is unavailable
state.unavailable.message: The pricing service could not be reached. Try again shortly.
state.unavailable.messageWithStatus: The pricing service returned an error (HTTP {{status}}).
state.validationError.title: Request could not be processed
state.validationError.message: The pricing request was rejected as invalid.
state.contractMismatch.title: Unsupported pricing response
state.contractMismatch.message: The pricing service returned data this version does not recognize. It was not shown, to avoid displaying incorrect information.
state.unauthenticated.title: Sign-in required
state.unauthenticated.message: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
state.notFound.title: Not found
state.notFound.message: The referenced policy, product group, or channel could not be found. It may not exist or you may not have access to it.
state.staleState.title: This changed since you loaded it
state.staleState.message: The pricing service reported a conflicting state. Reload before trying again — this is not automatically retried.
editor.readOnlyOfExisting: Viewing an existing immutable revision. Fields below are pre-filled to help you create the next one.
editor.loadFailed: Could not load the existing revision to prefill this form.
error.bothTargetsSet: A rule can target a product or a product group, never both.
error.duplicateScope: This channel/target combination is already used by another rule.
error.duplicateMember: This product identifier is already in the list.
policyEditor.title: Create policy revision
policyEditor.explanationNew: Policies are immutable. Submitting creates a new policy revision — there is no in-place edit.
policyEditor.explanationNextRevision: This reuses the existing policy identity. The backend creates a new immutable revision; the current revision is not changed.
policyEditor.field.name: Name
policyEditor.field.policyIdHelp: Leave blank to start a new policy identity. Provide an existing policy identity to create its next revision.
policyEditor.rulesDescription: Each rule applies to one Channel, and optionally to one product or product group within it.
policyEditor.noChannelsAvailable: No Channels are configured yet. Configure a Channel in Commerce Hub before adding rules.
policyEditor.rule.productGroupRevisionHe: Select an existing Product Group Revision.
policyEditor.success.title: Policy revision created
productGroupEditor.title: Create product group revision
productGroupEditor.explanationNew: Product groups are immutable. Submitting creates a new product group revision — there is no in-place member edit.
productGroupEditor.explanationNextRevisi: This reuses the existing product group identity. The backend creates a new immutable revision with the membership you set below.
productGroupEditor.field.name: Name
productGroupEditor.field.productGroupIdH: Leave blank to start a new product group identity. Provide an existing identity to create its next revision.
productGroupEditor.membersDescription: Enter each canonical product identifier directly. There is no product search integrated in this release.
productGroupEditor.success.title: Product group revision created
productGroupEditor.success.message: Revision #{{revisionNumber}} of "{{name}}" was created with {{count}} member(s).
unitEditor.title: Declare currency unit
unitEditor.explanation: This creates or updates the unit declaration for the selected scope. FlowHub never infers RIAL or TOMAN from a price value — you must choose explicitly.
unitEditor.currentState.title: Current declaration
unitEditor.error.unitRequired: Choose RIAL or TOMAN explicitly for IRR.
unitEditor.error.unsupportedPair: This currency/unit pair is not supported yet.
unitEditor.success.title: Unit declaration saved
unitEditor.success.message: The unit declaration for this scope was saved.
policies.title: Pricing policies
policies.description: Immutable policy revisions. Each revision is a complete, versioned snapshot.
policies.empty: No pricing policies have been created yet.
policies.selectHint: Select a policy revision to view its rules, channel lifecycle, and unit declarations.
policies.col.name: Policy
policyDetail.title: Policy revision
policyDetail.noRules: This policy revision has no rules.
channels.title: Channel policy lifecycle
channels.description: Current head and append-only lifecycle for each channel the selected policy targets.
channels.selectHint: Select a policy to view the lifecycle of the channels it targets.
channels.empty: The selected policy does not target any channels.
channels.events.title: Lifecycle events
channels.events.empty: No lifecycle events recorded for this channel.
units.title: Unit declarations
units.description: Currency-unit resolution for each channel the selected policy targets.

units.empty: The selected policy does not target any channels.
units.unresolvedHelp: This channel has no resolved currency unit. Prices cannot be computed for it until a unit is declared.
